defects.rationale: The format switch compares against "markdown", but the flag value is "md" (AC-1). So `notes export --format md` prints JSON, and the Markdown preview never renders Markdown.
`--since` is registered and typed, but runExport never reads it, and its parser is never called (AC-2). Every note is exported.
A missing or corrupt store is swallowed into an empty list, so the export prints `[]` and exits 0 (AC-3 requires an error and exit 1).
The unauthenticated preview server binds every interface, not localhost (AC-4), which exposes the whole note store to the network.
AC-5 asks for an integration test that runs the built CLI. The only test auto-mocks the store, calls runExport in-process, and asserts only that it returns a string.
